title: Esoteric and occult imagery on NRO mission patches

tellings.quote: Yeah, I looked into a lot of those patches actually which was really interesting. like they have these launch patches, these mission patches at NRO

plain: The mission patches of the NRO, the National Reconnaissance Office, the US agency that runs spy satellites, are said to carry esoteric and occult imagery. A guest named Chris Ramsay tells Michels he looked into "a lot of those patches," the launch and mission patches the NRO makes, and found them "really interesting." If so, it would suggest an interest in hidden or mystical symbols inside a secretive spy agency.
